question: Which Indian relay team set a national record in the 4x100m event at the National Relay Carnival 2025?

options.text: Gurindervir Singh, Animesh Kujur, Manikanta H, Amiya Mallick
Gurindervir Singh, Animesh Kujur, Manikanta H, Amlan Borgohain
Srabani Nanda, Dutee Chand, Hima Das, Archana Suseendran
Amiya Mallick, Mohammed Anas, Noah Nirmal Tom, Rajesh Ramesh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Gurindervir Singh, Animesh Kujur, Manikanta H, Amlan Borgohain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian 4x100m Relay Team:** The team comprising **Gurindervir Singh, Animesh Kujur, Manikanta H, and Amlan Borgohain** set a **national record** in the 4x100m event during the **National Relay Carnival, 2025**.
 
• This achievement showcases the team’s exceptional coordination, speed, and athletic prowess, as the relay event requires seamless passing of the baton and consistent performance from all members.
 
• **Amlan Borgohain:** A prominent sprinter and part of the team, has been known for his record-breaking performances in domestic athletic events. *Hence, the inclusion of his name is correct.*
 
• **National Relay Carnival:** This carnival is a prestigious event in Indian athletics, where various teams compete to showcase their skills in relay races. The 4x100m is one of the most anticipated events during the carnival.
 
• The achievement of setting a national record further highlights the continuous improvement and rising standards of Indian athletes on the national and international stage. *Hence, the correct answer is Gurindervir Singh, Animesh Kujur, Manikanta H, Amlan Borgohain.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Overview of Relay Races:**

 
 
• Relay races are track and field events in which teams of athletes run a sequence of legs, passing a baton from one runner to the next.
 
• The 4x100m relay is one of the most popular and fastest relay events globally, requiring exceptional sprinting ability and efficient baton exchanges.
 
 
 
• **National Relay Carnival:**
 
 
• The National Relay Carnival is an annual athletic event in India that focuses on team relay events, including 4x100m, 4x400m, and other variations.
 
• It serves as a platform for athletes to showcase their teamwork, coordination, and speed in competitive relay formats.
 
 
 
• **Individual Achievements:**
 
 
• **Gurindervir Singh:** Known for his consistent performances in national sprinting competitions.
 
• **Animesh Kujur:** An emerging talent in Indian athletics, contributing significantly to relay events.
 
• **Manikanta H:** A promising sprinter with a strong track record in relay races.
 
• **Amlan Borgohain:** Holds records in various sprinting categories and is one of India’s fastest sprinters.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Relay Races:**

 
 
• Relay races are crucial in athletics as they emphasize **teamwork**, coordination, and strategy alongside individual performance.
 
• The 4x100m relay is particularly significant as it tests **speed and precision** in baton exchanges, which often determine the outcome.
 
 
 
• **India’s Progress in Athletics:**
 
 
• India has seen considerable improvement in **athletics**, with athletes setting national and international records in recent years.
 
• Efforts by organizations like the **Athletics Federation of India** have played a significant role in developing talent and improving infrastructure.
